# Third-Party Notices

This is the attribution bundle for a binary release of HashCerebrum: the
copyright and permission notices of the third-party packages that ship inside
the app, reproduced exactly as their authors published them. Permissive
licenses (MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, OFL, Zlib) allow redistribution on the
condition that these notices travel with the binary, and Apache-2.0 also
requires that upstream `NOTICE` files be retained.

HashCerebrum's own license is the GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later; its full text is in
`LICENSE`, which ships beside this file. Nothing here changes that — these
notices cover other people's code.

It is generated by `npm run licenses` and must not be edited by hand.
[`THIRDPARTY-LICENSES.md`](THIRDPARTY-LICENSES.md) is the companion
inventory: every dependency in both lockfiles with its version and declared
license. This file is narrower on purpose — it carries only what a user
actually receives:

- **Rust:** every crate in `src-tauri/Cargo.lock`, including crates that only
  build on other platforms, because one notice file ships with every build.
- **npm:** only packages whose code or assets the production frontend build
  includes. Build and test tooling, and optional native packages that never
  reach a user, are left out.
- **Bundled assets:** the license files vendored next to the fonts and model
  weights in `public/`.

Identical notice text is printed once, with every package that ships it listed
above it. 390 distinct notices cover 1267 package files.

---

### Notice 2 — public/models/brain/LICENSE.md

Applies to:

- asset public/models/brain/LICENSE.md

```text
# Brain Model Asset

## Active model

- File: `science-museum-human-brain.glb`
- Title: `Model of a human brain`
- Creator / collection: Science Museum Group
- Source: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/model-of-a-human-brain-fc7ae7b989f94c80a50152e71f44e47c
- Collection page: https://collection.sciencemuseumgroup.org.uk/objects/co77087/model-of-a-human-brain
- License metadata in GLB: `CC0-1.0`
- License URL: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The bundled GLB metadata identifies the asset as public domain under CC0-1.0.
Attribution is not required by CC0, but the app keeps this source note so the
asset provenance is auditable before any public release.

The model exposes eight generic mesh nodes (`Object_2` through `Object_9`).
HashCerebrum maps these visible chunks to broad research regions in
`src/features/brain/data/modelParts.ts`. The source GLB does not separately
name internal structures such as hippocampus, amygdala, thalamus, or basal
ganglia, so those are assigned to the closest visible chunk for the first mode.
```

````text
# MedEmbed-small-v0.1 — license & attribution

This folder contains the **MedEmbed-small-v0.1** sentence-embedding model,
exported to ONNX (int8-quantised) for in-app, offline use.

- **Model:** MedEmbed-small-v0.1 (a medical/clinical fine-tune of bge-small)
- **Author:** Abhinand Balachandran
- **Source:** https://huggingface.co/abhinand/MedEmbed-small-v0.1
- **Project:** https://github.com/abhinand5/MedEmbed
- **License:** Apache License 2.0
- **Base model:** BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (MIT)
- **Use here:** inference only (text → 384-dim embedding). Not an LLM; nothing is
  trained at runtime. Loaded locally with `allowRemoteModels = false`, so it
  never contacts the network.

The Apache-2.0 license permits commercial use, modification, and redistribution
with attribution and retention of this notice. Full Apache-2.0 text:
https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

}
```
````
